newsitem.title: USA: Oilgear Co forms Canadian subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Oilgear Co forms Canadian subsidiary.

text.p: Oilgear Co said Thursday it formed a Canadian subsidiary, Oilgear-Canada Inc, in Ajax, Ontario.

Oilgear produces fluid power components, systems and electronic controls for the machine tool, automobile, petroleum, construction equipment, chemicals, plastics, glass, lumber, rubber and food industries.
Dale Boyke, vice president of sales and marketing for Oilgear, North America, will serve as president of the Canadian subsidiary.

Almost half of Oilgear's annual shipments are made and sold internationally or exported to customers outside the United States from the company's Milwaukee and Fremont, Nebraska, plants. Other international subsidiaries are in Australia, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, South Korea, Mexico, Spain, Taiwan and the United Kingdom.
